label: Deep Play at the Aperture
description: The threshold of translation, transduction, and dimensional reduction between symbolic description and actuator force.

label: Game 01: Instruction
description: Commands, directives, illocutionary force, and the direction of fit from world to token.

label: Game 02: Score
description: Notation, indeterminacy, graphic scores, and allographic execution.

label: Game 03: Program
description: Structured control flow, cellular messaging, literate programming, and algorithmic formalisms.

label: Game 04: Plan
description: Situated action, deictic representations, BDI architectures, and reactive survival.

label: Game 05: Query
description: Associative indexing, memex trails, vector space retrieval, and anomalous states of knowledge.

label: Game 06: Probe
description: Breaching experiments, cultural probes, ambiguous provocation, and background expectancies.

label: Game 07: Gesture
description: Visible bodily action, growth points, indexical pointing, and distributed maritime cognition.

label: Game 08: Commission
description: Client-patron contracts, conventions of art worlds, and actor-network negotiations.

label: Game 09: Conversation
description: Systematics of turn-taking, cooperative maxims, implicature, and common ground repair.

label: Game 10: Edit
description: Fluid text revision, hypertextual palimpsests, and social textual criticism.

label: Game 11: Constraint
description: Oulipian potential literature, lipograms, clinamen deviations, and Ulysses precommitments.

label: Game 12: Performance
description: Dramaturgical front stage, restored twice-behaved behavior, and mediatized liveness.

label: Activity in dynamic environments relies on indexical-functional entities, not objective world models.
name: DEICTIC-REPRESENTATION

label: Direction of fit originates in the asymmetry of mistake location between shopping list and detective log.
name: SHOPPING-LIST-DIRECTION-OF-FIT

label: Liveness is not an ontologically pristine presence but an effect produced and reconstituted by mediatization.
name: LIVENESS-AND-MEDIATIZATION

label: Performative failure is structural invalidity (infelicity) rather than falsehood.
name: INFELICITY-DOCTRINE

label: The Quattrocento art contract shifted value from material ostentation to specified individual skill.
name: COMMISSION-CONTRACT-PERIOD-EYE

label: Artistic production is coordinated through shared conventions across distributed networks of support personnel.
name: ART-WORLDS-AND-CONVENTIONS

label: Information queries cannot specify their targets because retrieval is motivated by an Anomalous State of Knowledge.
name: ANOMALOUS-STATE-OF-KNOWLEDGE

label: Future-directed intentions function as stabilizing execution anchors that limit the cognitive cost of continuous deliberation.
name: BDI-PLANS-AND-PRACTICAL-REASON

label: A text is not a static monument but an ongoing fluid stream of material revisions revealing cultural struggle.
name: FLUID-TEXT-AND-REVISION

label: Information retrieval should follow trails of associative interest rather than artificial hierarchical indexing.
name: MEMEX-TRAILS-AND-ASSOCIATION

label: Composition through chance operations purges personal taste to let acoustic events be themselves.
name: INDETERMINACY-AND-SILENCE

label: Graphic notation transfers compositional authority to performer interpretation by abolishing prescriptive pitch and duration.
name: GRAPHIC-SCORE-INTERPRETATION

label: Conversation requires continuous mutual grounding coordinated through the principle of least collaborative effort.
name: GROUNDING-AND-COMMON-GROUND

label: Bridging the gap between static textual program and dynamic execution process requires structured hierarchical control.
name: STRUCTURED-CONTROL-FLOW

label: Rational agents bind themselves to constraints to prevent catastrophic preference reversal under future passion.
name: PRECOMMITMENT-AND-CONSTRAINTS

label: Generative systems surrender heroic individual control in exchange for complex emergent behavior from interlocking uneven cycles.
name: GENERATIVE-MUSIC-SYSTEMS

label: Classical planning reduces action to state transition operators defined by preconditions, add lists, and delete lists under the closed-world assumption.
name: STRIPS-MEANS-ENDS-PLANNING

label: Social background expectancies become visible only when deliberately breached through procedural disruption.
name: BREACHING-BACKGROUND-EXPECTANCIES

label: Probes operate by provoking idiosyncratic responses through deliberate ambiguity and refusal of requirements.
name: CULTURAL-PROBES-AND-AMBIGUITY

label: Every text is a palimpsest written on the erased parchment of earlier texts through transformative and imitative operations.
name: PALIMPSESTS-AND-TRANSTEXTUALITY

label: Social interaction is an ongoing theatrical staging divided into front stage impression management and backstage preparation.
name: DRAMATURGICAL-FRONT-STAGE

label: A score functions allographically by defining an equivalence class that prevents identity drift through performance compliance.
name: ALLOGRAPHIC-NOTATION-IDENTITY

label: Conversational implicature operates by calculating meaning on the assumption that speakers honor the Cooperative Principle.
name: COOPERATIVE-MAXIMS-IMPLICATURE

label: Operative ekphrasis emerges when interpretation acquires machinery without requiring natural language to surrender its ambiguity.
name: LISTENER-WITH-ACTUATORS

label: A database schema is a knife whose handle is hidden beneath the table, enforcing precision through chosen blindness.
name: THE-KNIFE-DIMENSIONAL-CUT

label: Technological history fastens longer levers to shorter utterances, confusing causal leverage with genuine authorship.
name: THE-LEVER-AND-APERTURE

label: Description begins not as symbolic correspondence but as an embodied redirection of attention that singles out a difference.
name: THE-POINTING-HAND-INDEXICALITY

label: Cognition is not an individual internal computational process but a distributed computation across tools, space, and human bodies.
name: DISTRIBUTED-COGNITION-TOOLS

label: Object-oriented programming was conceived as recursive biological cells communicating via messages, not data structures with functions.
name: OBJECT-MESSAGING-BIOLOGY

label: Gesture is not auxiliary to speech but a co-constitutive kinesic component of the utterance.
name: GESTURE-AS-VISIBLE-ACTION

label: Literate programming inverts the priority of compiler over human reader by making narrative the primary architectural frame.
name: LITERATE-PROGRAMMING-WEB

label: Programming languages divide into an abstract semantic core and arbitrary syntactic sugar.
name: NEXT-700-LANGUAGES-ISWIM

label: A technological artifact exists only as long as an intersubjective network of actors agrees to maintain its reality.
name: ARAMIS-ACTOR-NETWORK-DEATH

label: Textual editing cannot recover autonomous authorial intention because texts are irreducibly social productions.
name: SOCIAL-TEXTUAL-APPARATUS

label: Thought originates in a 'growth point' where dialectical tension between holistic imagery and linear syntax unfolds.
name: GESTURAL-GROWTH-POINTS

label: Severe lexical constraint operates as an engine of narrative invention by making the missing vowel the hidden protagonist.
name: LIPOGRAMMATIC-EXCLUSION

label: Arbitrary formal constraint forces creative escape from cognitive cliché, with the clinamen preserving freedom.
name: OULIPO-POTENTIAL-LITERATURE

label: Conversation allocates turns locally and recursively through projected Transition-Relevance Places without centralized governance.
name: CONVERSATIONAL-TURN-TAKING

label: Information retrieval spatializes textual semantics into orthogonal geometric dimensions of term frequency.
name: VECTOR-SPACE-RETRIEVAL

label: Performance is restored behavior—twice-behaved behavior strip-mined from origin and reassembled.
name: RESTORED-BEHAVIOR-RITUAL

label: Illocutionary acts classify exhaustively along direction of fit and expressed psychological state.
name: ILLOCUTIONARY-FORCE-TAXONOMY

label: Design can actively prevent premature closure by engineering multiple simultaneous, open interpretations.
name: INTERPRETIVE-FLEXIBILITY-DESIGN

label: Plans are derivative representations and retrospective accounts of situated action, not generative control structures.
name: SITUATED-ACTIONS-VS-PLANS

label: Language is a dance of social commitments mapped through a state machine of speech acts, not information transfer.
name: COMMITMENT-MACHINES-LANGUAGE

label: Direction of Fit
description: The fundamental asymmetry between word-to-world (assertive report) and world-to-word (directive actuation).

label: The Knife & Dimensional Cut
description: The dimensional collapse occurring when infinite symbolic text is executed through physical or cybernetic actuators.

label: Deictic Representation
description: Indexical-functional coupling to the environment without global internal world models.

label: Ekphrastic Illusion
description: The conflation of vivid narrative description with causal mechanical compliance.

label: Speech Act Felicity
description: Conditions under which performative utterances succeed or misfire.

label: Situated Action
description: Ad hoc, reflexive action in dynamic environments where plans are retrospective accounts.

label: Allographic Score
description: Notation systems that identify a work through compliance rather than physical provenance.

label: Fluid Text & Palimpsest
description: Textual materiality as an ongoing sequence of social revisions and traces.

label: Conversational Grounding
description: The collaborative establishment of mutual belief through least collaborative effort.

label: Oulipian Constraint & Clinamen
description: Systematic voluntary restrictions producing generative combinatorial freedom.

label: Restored Twice-Behaved Behavior
description: The theatrical and ritual repetition of actions independent of their causal origin.

label: Ethnomethodological Breaching
description: Deliberate violation of implicit social expectancies to reveal institutional scaffolding.

label: [[the-knife-counter-cut]]
description: The unmodelled physical friction and blade wear produced on the tool during actuation.

label: [[subordinate-listener-break]]
description: The point of breakdown when a passive receiver refuses or fails to translate instruction into force.

label: [[ekphrastic-remainder]]
description: What is discarded when a continuous physical state is digitized into descriptive tokens.

label: [[incomputable-friction]]
description: The substrate resistance that prevents closed-loop formal convergence in dynamic environments.

label: [[aperture-threshold]]
description: The boundary condition where symbolic communication becomes mechanical impedance.
